rationale: Residual load after hydro and storage is 75/90/85 MW for h1/h2/h3 (total 250 MWh). Coal is cheaper (22 vs 38 USD/MWh) and its emissions (0.75*250=187.5 t) stay under the 200 t cap, so the least-cost feasible dispatch serves all residual load from coal within its 40-100 MW online range; gas is off.
